mechanism: Establish one original clearly adult miniature traveler, at least two near scale anchors, three materially different route zones and one elevated destination that is visible or spatially recoverable from the opening. Move the traveler through every zone in a continuous objective direction, and require each material to change the locomotion verb—such as stepping, balancing, sliding, climbing or sprinting. The landing or recovery from one zone must physically hand off to the next; do not reset identity, wardrobe or route. Reach the previously established elevated destination through a visible final ascent and hold a wide terminal view that includes the adult and at least two prior material families. The reusable mechanism is miniature scale proof, multi-material locomotion relay, continuous destination logic, action-to-action handoff and elevated route closure—not the source person, face, clothing, breakfast food, syrup, cereal, pancake, kitchen, palette, exact terrain order, camera path, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Establish one clearly adult miniature traveler, at least two near scale anchors, three material zones and one elevated destination before the route escalates.
invariants.purpose: Makes both miniature scale and the promised endpoint recoverable.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a destination and scale baseline, the sequence becomes unrelated macro vignettes.

invariants.rule: Give every material zone a different locomotion verb.
invariants.ablation_failure: Running identically across every surface makes material changes functionally meaningless.

invariants.rule: Use the landing or recovery from one zone as the physical entry into the next while preserving objective direction.
invariants.purpose: Builds a continuous causal route across discontinuous textures.
invariants.ablation_failure: Resetting between terrains turns the adventure into a montage.

invariants.rule: Preserve adult identity, wardrobe and at least one recurring route cue through every scale change.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the same traveler and geography verifiable.
invariants.ablation_failure: A tiny silhouette alone cannot prove continuity after major environment changes.

invariants.rule: Reach the established high destination through a visible final ascent and hold a wide view containing at least two prior material families.
invariants.purpose: Proves arrival and route completion instead of merely posing on a new object.
invariants.ablation_failure: A sudden summit cut breaks the promised traversal.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source miniature human, face, clothing, body proportions and exact running performance
the source butter cubes, berries, crumbs, syrup, strawberry, cereal rings, pancakes and cup
the source breakfast table, kitchen scale illusion, warm sunrise lighting and saturated food palette
the source exact terrain order, jumps, balance actions, run path, summit composition and camera route
the source creator identity, MiniMax H3 attribution wording and 15-second timing
